question: The length, the breadth and the height of a closed cuboidal box are 2.5 m, 2 m and 90 cm, respectively. What would be the cost of a canvas needed to cover this box completely, if the cost of the canvas is ₹70 per m²?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2 × (lb + bh + hl)

TSA = 2 × (2.5 × 2 + 2 × 0.9 + 0.9 × 2.5) = 2 × (5 + 1.8 + 2.25) = 18.1 m²

Total Cost = Total Area × Rate per m²

Total Cost = 18.1 × 70 = 1267

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1267.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length (l) of the box = 2.5 m

Breadth (b) of the box = 2 m

Height (h) of the box = 90 cm = 0.9 m

Cost of the canvas = ₹70 per m²
